name: Monkey Hub VR
summary:
Welcome to Monkey Hub VR!
Monkey Hub VR is an immersive social hub with tons off fun game modes and maps such as Monke Games a crab game inspired game mode featuring unique Korean children's games or the horror mode were you break into the subliminal side of Monkey Hub VR and fight the mysterious entities.

Experience a world like no other with not just your self but up to 10 players. Monkey Hub VR is a huge world with much to offer and is a place for everyone to let out there inner monkey! 🐵
